[raw:sources/SBF_s_trial_starts_soon_but_how_did_he_and_FTX_get_here]
The highly anticipated criminal trial for Sam Bankman-Fried, former CEO of bankrupt crypto exchange FTX, started Tuesday to determine whether he’s guilty of seven counts of fraud and conspiracy. And as one former federal prosecutor put it: “The odds seem to be stacked against him at this point.”

[sources/Is_Sam_Bankman-Fried_a_bad_man_or_a_good_boy_Lawyers_swap_opening_statements_before_first_witnesses_take_the_stand]
The trial focuses on whether Sam Bankman-Fried, former CEO of FTX, is a liar and fraud or a well-meaning founder. The prosecution portrays him as a criminal who stole billions from thousands of victims, while his defense argues he acted in good faith.

[sources/SBF_s_trial_starts_soon_but_how_did_he_and_FTX_get_here]
This document discusses the start of Sam Bankman-Fried's criminal trial for fraud and conspiracy related to FTX, a bankrupt cryptocurrency exchange. It traces the rise and fall of FTX, highlighting its rapid growth, celebrity endorsements, and eventual collapse due to liquidity issues and regulatory concerns.

[raw:sources/Is_Sam_Bankman-Fried_a_bad_man_or_a_good_boy_Lawyers_swap_opening_statements_before_first_witnesses_take_the_stand]
Who is Sam Bankman-Fried, the former CEO of crypto exchange FTX? Is he a liar and a fraud? Or did he act in good faith, and like many a startup founder, fly too close to the sun?

[raw:sources/SBF_s_trial_starts_soon_but_how_did_he_and_FTX_get_here]
In January, Bankman-Fried pleaded not guilty to all counts, which include wire fraud, conspiracy to commit money laundering and conspiracy to misuse customer funds. He could face up to 115 years in jail if convicted on all charges.

[raw:sources/SBF_riding_high_on_FTX_reportedly_offered_5B_to_Trump_to_cancel_President_re-run]
Come Tuesday, our eyes will be trained on the Manhattan Federal Court for the trial of Sam Bankman-Fried, the disgraced cryptocurrency entrepreneur accused of orchestrating “one of the biggest financial frauds in American history”: the multibillion-dollar collapse of FTX, the crypto exchange he founded and led.
